info.title: Neomorphic Continuous Monitoring
info.description: Finite public HTTPS GET observations and durable authenticated inbox delivery. The mounted manifest reports current availability separately from artifact history. Tenant credentials and an existing finite entitlement are required for private operations. No automatic charges or billing automation.

servers.description: Same-origin mounted API base. Read /v1/manifest for effective availability and access limits.

get.description: Credential-free exact bytes of this mounted contract. No tenant, grant, scheduler or monitor is created.

200.description: Configured PostgreSQL API and local source are ready. Observation readiness is reported separately.

503.description: API readiness cannot be established. No tenant entitlement is granted.

200.description: Mounted runtime, artifact provenance, exact contract and access limits.

503.description: Disabled, unavailable or unverified source; contract acquisition is withheld.

get.description: List at most 50 of this tenant's retained monitors.

post.description: Owner only. A stable Idempotency-Key and identical raw JSON replay the original monitor. No payment or provider credential accepted.

get.description: Inspect this tenant's configuration, lifecycle, evidence pointers and usage.

patch.description: Owner only. Monitor must be paused and have no outstanding claim. Counters never reset. Source, mode and fields cannot change.

get.description: Read immutable factual events. after=0 explicitly resyncs from the oldest retained event; an expired nonzero cursor returns 410.
Owner only. Durably claims due inbox events. An unread/lost reply retries with the same event key after visibility backoff, at most eight attempts. GET has delivery-state side effects.
Read delivery state and attempt history. delivered is true only after the authenticated consumer acknowledges.

post.description: Owner only. Echo stable event key after consuming it idempotently. Requires a prior inbox read. Repeating the acknowledgement preserves its original timestamp.

get.description: Measured and conservatively reserved cost inputs. Cost total and provider rates remain unknown. No automatic charge.
Recent immutable run receipts, latest first. At most 100 retained; this endpoint returns at most 50.
Read one retained immutable run receipt. 404 if unknown, different tenant or purged.
Read retained immutable evidence. Original and current baseline are pinned until terminal-monitor retention. Failure evidence never becomes a numeric zero.

post.description: Owner only. Pause/resume retain baseline; cancel and expiry are terminal. Existing events stay deliverable.
Owner only. Pause/resume retain baseline; cancel and expiry are terminal. Existing events stay deliverable.
Owner only. Pause/resume retain baseline; cancel and expiry are terminal. Existing events stay deliverable.

tenantBearer.description: Operator-provisioned opaque token, scoped to tenant and owner/reader role. No provider secrets.

url.description: Public HTTPS:443 only, no credentials/query/fragment/opaque credential paths. Exact mounted loopback origin is private demo configuration only.

MonitorInput.description: Tenant plan ceilings apply. json requires pointers; observatory requires sourceId; expiry cannot exceed entitlement. maxBytes must reserve maxBodyBytes + 65536, and maxRuntimeMs must reserve timeoutMs.

available.description: Configured API, fresh store/schema readiness and matched local source. This does not grant tenant access or promise capacity.

observationsAvailable.description: The API is available and its existing scheduler is enabled. Tenant authority and finite budgets still apply.

providerBuildQualified.description: Local source consistency is separate from canonical provider/build qualification.

artifact.description: Immutable packaging provenance, not current deployment/readiness.

Forbidden.description: Reader credential, expired entitlement for new work, or browser Origin refused

Conflict.description: Idempotency, lifecycle, budget or acknowledgement conflict
